name: Death Of Christ The
overview: The Death of Christ, as depicted in Matthew 27:26-31, reveals the humility and suffering of Jesus as He was scourged, mocked, and led to crucifixion. These verses illustrate the ignominious and voluntary nature of His death, which was inflicted by Gentile soldiers yet appointed by God for the redemption of mankind. The mockery and physical abuse He endured emphasize both the rejection He faced and the sacrificial purpose of His death, which is commemorated in the Lord's Supper and prefigured in Scripture.
